question: Does the latest normal DLL pass a bounded headset-free startup observation and clean shutdown, rather than merely survive until the watchdog?
claim: Not fully. Run 12 with the exact normal DLL installed all three optional-menu-record guard hooks after four unique signature checks, observed constructed count 4 and unavailable fifth record, reached acknowledged private xr-sim and survived the 150-second startup window plus 120-second native-quit grace without a startup AV. No UI input was delivered during the grace. The supervisor then requested window close at 08:35:54.5871513Z, followed by native read AV c0000005 at preferred VA 0x10ad4095/address 0x0000000c at 08:35:54.603Z and self-termination code 0. The hardened final-log checker correctly fails the overall run. FarCry2 is stopped and original files, five saves and exact inventory are independently restored. The native menu-driven Quit comparison was not launched because subsequent preflight found Swat4X running.
method: Latest run: scripts/Test-NativeScenario.ps1 -Run -StartupOnly -ProductionProxy -MaxSeconds 150 -MenuQuitGraceSeconds 120, using the explicitly hashed menu-record-guard-2-production/dinput8.dll and retained config/profile/800x800 headset fixtures. The local build/startup-isolation-1/run-control.ps1 supplies exact game/runtime/save paths and a fresh out/startup-isolation-20261026-12-production-verification directory. Suspended creation binds PID 141948, image path, creation ticks and affinity 65535 before resume. Process-scoped x86 xr-sim 1.0.0 with D3D11 bridge; no global runtime switch. Fleet process/path/name preflight found no game before launch; Unreal build tools were excluded, not stopped. Inspect actual native log, four unique signature results, count-four guard proof, 11-command PID/sequence bootstrap acknowledgement, live input/frame progress and final log. The two-stage discriminator is startup survival versus native shutdown after the recorded close request. Retained older controls distinguish no-VR/spare zero, VR/spare garbage, and guard-on/off using the same debug DLL, but run 12 itself is a front-end observation, not a gameplay/scenario pass. All 61 CTest groups rerun with CMake/CTest and Python 3.12.3 after launcher changes. Read-only PowerShell independent current hashes/inventory and process inspection recorded in summary.json. Receipt initialized using registered in-house ID then adapted to this local contribution identity; no fleet submission.

do_not_repeat.approach: Treat StartupSurvived, Forced=false, or native self-termination code 0 as a clean shutdown/build pass
do_not_repeat.reason: Runs 10 and 12 survive startup but log a native access violation immediately after window close. The old cleanup success flag missed that post-close evidence; the new final-log check fails it.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: An actual native menu-driven Quit and final-log check are completed on the same normal DLL/fixture, with no fleet game overlap; fix any remaining close fault only against its target-specific receiver/ownership proof.

do_not_repeat.approach: Read or mutate spare native record bytes as if readability or a plausible pointer proves construction
do_not_repeat.reason: The exact menu container has only four constructed records, while unchecked index 4 reads spare allocation contents that vary with VR allocation layout. A synthetic fifth record or a global callback-destructor bypass would conceal the ownership defect.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: A different exact-image/asset layout proves a genuinely constructed extra record, including descriptor count and native record identity; retain ordinary native behavior for that case.
